heading.en: Origins and the Jäger years

body.zh-Hant: 據芬蘭瑞典語傳記辭典（BLF），胡戈·維克托·厄斯特曼1892年9月5日生於赫爾辛基，父親是警官。他1915年加入普魯士第27獵兵營，1918年內戰中擔任營長，參與坦佩雷一帶的戰鬥，之後又以團長身分出現在維堡戰役中。
body.en: According to the Biografiskt lexikon för Finland (BLF), Hugo Viktor Österman was born in Helsinki on 5 September 1892, the son of a police official. He joined the Prussian Jäger Battalion 27 in 1915, served as a battalion commander in the 1918 civil war with fighting at Tampere, and later appears as a regimental commander at the battle of Viipuri.

citations.quote: född 5.9.1892 i Helsingfors
son till en polis i Helsingfors
Ö. anslöt sig 1915 till Preussiska jägarbataljonen 27
deltog i kriget 1918 som bataljonskommendör vid Tfrs
som regementskommendör vid Viborg
Han ledde den bland annat i striderna vid Tammerfors

heading.en: Regiment, division and infantry inspector

body.zh-Hant: 據瑞典語芬蘭百科（Uppslagsverket Finland），厄斯特曼1919至1925年任波里團團長，1925至1927年任第3師師長，1927至1933年任步兵總監。BLF另載，他在其間赴瑞典戰爭學院進修。1930年他出任信霍武德內閣的國防部副部長，1932年署理新地區省長；兩份來源對副部長的年份不一致，已列為缺漏。
body.en: According to Uppslagsverket Finland, Österman headed the Pori Regiment in 1919–25, the 3rd Division in 1925–27 and was Inspector of Infantry in 1927–33. BLF adds that he studied at the war college in Sweden in between. BLF places his deputy defence minister post in the Svinhufvud government of 1930 and Uppslagsverket places it in 1931–32; he was acting governor of Uusimaa in 1932. The two sources disagree on the deputy-minister years, recorded as a gap.

citations.quote: 1919-25 chef för Björneborgs regemente
1925-27 för 3. divisionen
1927-33 inspektör för infanteriet
Däremellan hann han också studera vid Krigshögskolan i Sverige
utnämndes Österman till biträdande försvarsminister i
bitr. försvarsminister 1931 -32
tf. landshövding i Nylands län 1932

heading.zh-Hant: 國防軍司令與冬季戰爭
heading.en: Commander of the armed forces and the Winter War

body.zh-Hant: Uppslagsverket 載，厄斯特曼1933至1940年擔任國防軍司令（befälhavare för krigsmakten）。BLF指出，他接替被迫辭職的西沃，在任上盡力在有限預算下重建國防。冬季戰爭爆發時他受命指揮卡累利阿地峽軍；1940年2月因與總司令在作戰上看法不合離職，由埃里克·海因里克斯接任。BLF認為地峽防線崩潰主因是敵方物資優勢，而非他的處置。
body.en: Uppslagsverket records Österman as commander of the armed forces in 1933–40. BLF says he succeeded Aarne Sihvo, who had been forced to resign, and that he built up the defence as far as the scant budget allowed. At the outbreak of the Winter War he took command of the Army of the Karelian Isthmus, but left in February 1940 after operational disagreement with the commander-in-chief; Erik Heinrichs replaced him. BLF considers the collapse of the front the result of overwhelming material pressure, not of his measures.

citations.quote: 1933-40 befälhavare för krigsmakten
utsågs den svenskspråkige Österman i hans ställe
Rikets försvar byggdes upp så gott de knappt tilltagna budgetanslagen tillät
Vid krigsutbrottet 1939 fick han befälet över Karelska näsets armé
lämnade i februari 1940 sin post
ersattes av Erik Heinrichs
Fronten bröt samman inför ett övermäktigt materiellt tryck

heading.en: Continuation War and after

body.zh-Hant: 繼續戰爭開始時，厄斯特曼希望再獲前線職務，但曼納海姆認為他在冬季戰爭已有機會，未予同意。Uppslagsverket載他1941至1946年任步兵總監；BLF補充，1944年他曾有數月擔任總司令駐德軍司令部代表。1946年他自現役退休，其後長期在工商界工作。
body.en: When the Continuation War began, Österman wanted a front command again, but Mannerheim held that he had already had his chance in the Winter War. Uppslagsverket records him as Inspector of Infantry in 1941–46, and BLF adds that in 1944 he served for some months as the commander-in-chief's representative at the German war leadership. He retired from active service in 1946 and worked in business for a long time afterwards.

citations.quote: Mannerheim gick dock inte med på detta
1941-46 inspektör för infanteriet
representant vid den tyska krigsledningen
avgick Österman 1946 från aktiv tjänst
arbetade därefter ännu länge inom näringslivet

heading.en: Origins and the Jäger artillerist

body.zh-Hant: 據BLF與Uppslagsverket，勞里·馬爾姆貝里1888年5月8日生於赫爾辛基，是作家艾諾·馬爾姆貝里之子。他1914年自工學院電機系畢業，1915年冬赴德國加入第27獵兵營，是該營炮兵；1916至1917年在東線波羅的海戰區升任炮兵連長，1918年2月隨獵兵返國時已晉升少校。
body.en: According to BLF and Uppslagsverket, Lauri Malmberg was born in Helsinki on 8 May 1888, son of the author Aino Malmberg. He graduated as an electrical engineer from the Technical University in 1914 and followed his comrades to Germany in the winter of 1915, serving as an artillerist in Jäger Battalion 27. He rose to battery commander on the eastern front in the Baltics in 1916–17 and was a major when the Jägers left for Finland in February 1918.

citations.quote: son till Aino Malmberg
utexaminerades som diplomingenjör från avdelningen för elteknik vid Tekniska
Vintern 1915 följde Malmberg sina kamrater till Tyskland
östfronten i Baltikum 1916–1917, där han avancerade till batterichef
När jägarna avreste till Finland i februari 1918
hade Malmberg blivit befordrad till major

heading.en: The 1918 war and the artillery regiment

body.zh-Hant: BLF載，1918年他先任獵兵炮兵營長，在坦佩雷戰役中改率步兵支隊沿奈西耶爾維湖東岸推進，其後以獵兵炮兵旅長身分參加卡累利阿前線的戰鬥與攻占維堡。Uppslagsverket記他1918至1922年任野戰炮兵第1團團長。
body.en: BLF records that in 1918 he first led the Jäger artillery division north of Tampere, then at the battle of Tampere commanded an infantry detachment advancing along the east shore of Lake Näsijärvi; afterwards, as commander of the Jäger artillery brigade, he fought on the Karelian front and in the taking of Viipuri. Uppslagsverket lists him as commander of Field Artillery Regiment 1 in 1918–22.

citations.quote: chef för jägarartilleridivisionen vid fronten norr om Tammerfors
infanteriavdelning som ryckte fram längs Näsijärvis östra strand
kommendör för jägarartilleribrigaden i striderna på den karelska fronten
var med om intagningarna av Tammerfors och Viborg
1918-22 kommendör för Fältartilleriregementet 1

heading.zh-Hant: 護國團司令與國防部長
heading.en: Civic Guard chief and Minister of Defence

body.zh-Hant: 1921年秋護國團領導層出現政治危機，馬爾姆貝里在友人與國防部長說服下接掌護國團，次年晉升上校。Uppslagsverket記他1921至1945年任護國團司令。BLF載他1924年5月底出任英格曼內閣國防部長，同時兼護國團職務；任期不足一年，期間推動軍官教育法與海岸防衛艦隊法。
body.en: In autumn 1921 a political crisis arose in the leadership of the Civic Guards and, after persuasion by a friend and the defence minister, Malmberg took over; he was promoted colonel in 1922. Uppslagsverket lists him as commander of the Civic Guards in 1921–45. BLF says he became defence minister in Lauri Ingman's government at the end of May 1924 while keeping his Civic Guard duties; the term was under a year and brought laws on officer education and on a coastal defence fleet.

citations.quote: Hösten 1921 uppstod en politisk kris i skyddskårernas ledning
Efter en lång tvekan gick Malmberg med på att åta sig uppgiften
befordran till överste 1922
1921-45 befälhavare för skyddskårerna
I slutet av maj 1924 utsågs Malmberg till försvarsminister
vid sidan av sina uppgifter som befälhavare för skyddskårerna
Malmbergs knappt ett år långa period som försvarsminister

heading.zh-Hant: 拉普亞運動與曼特薩拉事件
heading.en: The Lapua Movement and the Mäntsälä revolt

body.zh-Hant: BLF載，拉普亞運動使護國團處境艱難；1932年2月曼特薩拉事件中，馬爾姆貝里奉總統之命前往曼特薩拉結束叛亂，並把叛亂首領瓦倫紐斯帶回赫爾辛基。BLF另載，因政界對他的不信任，他在1933年下半年請了一年的留職，赴瑞典與英國考察防衛組織。
body.en: BLF says the Lapua Movement put the Civic Guards under his command in one of the most difficult situations in the organisation's history. In the Mäntsälä revolt of February 1932 he was ordered by the president to end the uprising and drove its leader, K. M. Wallenius, to Helsinki. Because of growing distrust in political circles he had to request a year's leave in the latter half of 1933 and used it to study defence organisation in Sweden and Britain.

citations.quote: Lapporörelsen försatte skyddskårerna under Malmbergs befäl
händelse i februari 1932 som blev känd som Mäntsäläupproret
Malmberg fick dock uppdraget att göra slut på upproret
bad upprorets ledare K. M. Wallenius stiga in i bilen
under senare hälften av 1933 blev tvungen att anhålla om ett års tjänstledighet

heading.zh-Hant: 本土部隊司令與護國團解散
heading.en: Home troops and the end of the Civic Guards

body.zh-Hant: Uppslagsverket載，馬爾姆貝里1939至1945年任本土部隊司令。BLF指出，他在冬季戰爭與繼續戰爭期間負責組建並訓練新部隊；1944年夏因酗酒問題，曼納海姆命他休假治療。1944年10月底至11月初，管制委員會下令解散護國團，他於1945年初退入編外，同年底正式離開國防軍。
body.en: Uppslagsverket lists Malmberg as commander of the home troops in 1939–45. BLF says he oversaw the creation and training of new units during both the Winter War and the Continuation War; in summer 1944 Mannerheim ordered him on leave to treat alcoholism. At the turn of October–November 1944 the Control Commission ordered the Civic Guards dissolved; he was put on reserve status in early 1945 and left the armed forces formally at the end of that year.

citations.quote: 1939-45 kommendör för hemmatrupperna
Malmberg skötte denna uppgift under vinterkriget
sommaren 1944 beordrade Mannerheim honom att ta ledigt
i månadsskiftet oktober–november 1944
I början av 1945 sattes han på indragningsstat
i slutet av samma år lämnade han försvarsmakten även formellt

heading.en: Origins and the Jäger years

body.zh-Hant: 據BLF，帕沃·塔爾韋拉1897年2月19日生於赫爾辛基縣（Helsinge），是十一個孩子中最小的一個。他從商業學校直接前往德國受獵兵訓練，參加米斯河與里加灣戰鬥。1918年內戰中他以化名「Strömsten」先攻克克里斯蒂娜卡爾佩，其後在薩塔昆塔的右翼作戰。
body.en: According to BLF, Paavo Talvela was born at Helsinge on 19 February 1897, the youngest of eleven children. He went to Germany for Jäger training straight from commercial school and fought at Misse and the Gulf of Riga. In the 1918 war, under the cover name Strömsten, he first took part in the conquest of Kristinestad and then operated on the right wing of the front in Satakunta.

heading.en: The Eastern Karelian expeditions

body.zh-Hant: RUL簡歷載，塔爾韋拉1919至1920年擔任奧涅加遠征軍（Aunus）總司令。BLF說他很快成為整個遠征軍的總指揮，並進入臨時奧涅加政府；遠征以屈辱撤退告終。1921年他又以營長身分加入南面的志願軍，後升為全部志願部隊指揮官，參加雷波拉、波拉耶爾維等戰鬥，1922年再度撤退。
body.en: The RUL record lists Talvela as commander-in-chief of the Aunus (Olonets) expedition in 1919–20. BLF says he quickly became commander of the whole expedition and a member of the temporary Aunus government; the campaign ended in a humiliating retreat. In 1921 he joined a free corps further south as battalion commander and rose to command of all its volunteers, fighting at Repola and Porajärvi, and had to retreat again in 1922.

heading.zh-Hant: 兩次大戰之間：參謀、拉普亞與商界
heading.en: Between the wars: staff, Lapua and business

body.zh-Hant: RUL簡歷載，塔爾韋拉1927至1929年任總參謀部指揮處處長，1929至1930年任作戰處處長，1930年5月30日退役。BLF說，他是拉普亞運動的核心成員，也是1930年7月農民進軍的組織者；之後轉入商界，1932年起任國營酒類公司Alko副總經理，1937年轉任芬蘭纖維素協會副總經理。
body.en: The RUL record lists Talvela as head of the General Staff command department in 1927–29 and of the operations department in 1929–30, retiring on 30 May 1930. BLF says he belonged to the inner circle of the Lapua Movement and organised the farmers' march of July 1930; he then moved into business, becoming deputy director of the state alcohol monopoly Alko in 1932 and of the Finnish Cellulose Association in 1937.

heading.zh-Hant: 冬季戰爭：塔爾韋拉集群與托爾瓦耶爾維
heading.en: Winter War: Group Talvela and Tolvajärvi

body.zh-Hant: BLF載，1939年秋他以預備役少將身分受召，冬季戰爭爆發後12月初奉命率「塔爾韋拉集群」守拉多加湖以北的托爾瓦耶爾維—伊洛曼齊—艾托約基一線；12月中旬前在托爾瓦耶爾維戰役取得芬軍冬季戰爭首批勝利。2月底他改任地峽東部軍團長，戰爭最後幾週接掌原由海因里克斯指揮、守武奧克西—蘇萬托防線的軍團。
body.en: BLF says that in autumn 1939 he was called back as a major general of the reserve and that at the start of December, after the Winter War broke out, he was ordered to lead Group Talvela north of Lake Ladoga on the Tolvajärvi–Ilomantsi–Aittojoki sector; before mid-December his troops won the first Finnish victories of the war at Tolvajärvi. At the end of February he became a corps commander on the eastern Karelian Isthmus, taking over in the last weeks the corps on the Vuoksi–Suvanto line formerly led by Erik Heinrichs.

body.zh-Hant: BLF載，1941年8月3日總司令向他頒發曼納海姆十字勳章，他率第6軍團於同年9月抵達斯維里河。1942年1月起他任總司令駐德軍司令部代表，至1944年2月；1944年返國後出任奧涅加集群司令，指揮1944年夏初自東卡累利阿的撤退，7月再度被派往德國，9月停戰後返國。1946至1949年他在巴西與阿根廷推銷芬蘭纖維素。
body.en: BLF says that on 3 August 1941 the commander-in-chief awarded him the Mannerheim Cross, and that his VI Corps reached the Svir in September 1941. From January 1942 until February 1944 he was the commander-in-chief's representative at German headquarters; on his return in 1944 he commanded the Aunus Group in the retreat from East Karelia in early summer, was sent to Germany again in July, and returned after the armistice in September. In 1946–49 he sold Finnish cellulose in Brazil and Argentina.

heading.en: Origins, officer and the Russian years

body.zh-Hant: 據BLF，魯道夫·瓦爾登1878年12月1日生於赫爾辛基，1900年自芬蘭幼年學校（卡德特軍校）畢業。兩年後，他因拒絕以軍人身分參與他認為非法的徵兵而被軍事最高法院判決免職。其後他前往俄國，先在造紙廠與印刷廠任職，1911年起任芬蘭造紙廠駐外代表。
body.en: According to BLF, Rudolf Walden was born in Helsinki on 1 December 1878 and graduated from the Finnish Cadet Corps in 1900. Two years later he was dismissed from active service by a decision of the Supreme Court Martial after refusing to take part, as a military member, in conscription drafts he regarded as illegal. He went to Russia, first working as a director of a paper mill and a printing house and from 1911 as representative of the Finnish paper mills.

citations.quote: född 1.12.1878 i Helsingfors
utexaminerades från Finska kadettkåren i Fredrikshamn 1900
avskedades ur aktiv militär tjänst
som han betraktade som olagliga
från 1911 som representant för de finländska pappersbruken

heading.en: 1918 war and Minister of War

body.zh-Hant: RUL簡歷載，瓦爾登1918年2月3日以中尉身分加入芬蘭軍，3月5日任總司令部後勤長，6月20日離開正規軍職。BLF說他不是前線軍人，被曼納海姆迅速提升為上校並放在核心參謀職位。1918年11月27日他出任英格曼內閣戰爭部長，1919年4月起留任卡斯特倫內閣，至8月15日卸任；任內通過首部兵役法。
body.en: The RUL record shows Walden joined the Finnish army as a lieutenant on 3 February 1918, became head of the supply (etappi) service at headquarters on 5 March and left regular service on 20 June. BLF says he was no front-line soldier: Mannerheim promoted him rapidly to colonel and placed him in central staff posts. He became Minister of War on 27 November 1918 in the Ingman government, stayed on in the Castrén government from April 1919 and left office on 15 August 1919; the first conscription law came in his term.

heading.zh-Hant: 造紙業領袖與塔爾圖和談
heading.en: Paper industry leader and the Tartu negotiations

body.zh-Hant: BLF載，1920年瓦爾登是芬蘭和平代表團成員，出席塔爾圖和談；他極力主張東卡累利阿併入芬蘭但失敗，只在佩特薩莫歸屬上獲得安慰。同年他主導將西姆佩萊、米利科斯基與耶姆塞科斯基三家造紙廠合併為聯合造紙廠（UPM）。RUL簡歷載他1920至1946年任該公司董事長並實際擔任總經理。
body.en: BLF says that in 1920 Walden was a member of the Finnish peace delegation at the Tartu negotiations; he pressed hard for the union of East Karelia with Finland but lost, with the attachment of Petsamo as a small consolation. In 1920, at his initiative, the mills at Myllykoski, Jämsänkoski and Simpele merged into Yhtyneet paperitehtaat (UPM). The RUL record lists him as chairman of its board, and in practice managing director, in 1920–46.

heading.zh-Hant: 拉普亞運動與防衛委員會
heading.en: The Lapua Movement and the Defence Council

body.zh-Hant: BLF載，1930年他獲選為拉普亞運動所設「芬蘭之鎖」代表團成員，並一度被推為運動的獨裁者人選，但他拒絕。1932年曼特薩拉事件時運動又要求他領導政府，運動瓦解後他逐漸與右翼激進派保持距離。RUL簡歷載他1931至1940年任國防委員會成員。他在1939年12月被召回現役，任總司令駐政府代表。
body.en: BLF says that in 1930 Walden was elected to the delegation of Suomen Lukko, set up by the Lapua Movement, and was even put forward as its dictator candidate, which he declined. During the Mäntsälä revolt of 1932 the movement again demanded that he head the government; after the movement collapsed he gradually distanced himself from the radical right. The RUL record lists him as a member of the Defence Council in 1931–40. In December 1939 he was called back to service as the commander-in-chief's representative in the cabinet.

heading.en: Defence Minister and last years

body.zh-Hant: RUL簡歷載，瓦爾登1940年3月27日出任國防部長，至1944年11月27日連續在任；BLF說他先後留任於呂提、蘭格爾、林科米耶斯與哈克策爾等內閣，並第三次參加對蘇和談代表團。1944年12月2日他獲頒曼納海姆十字勳章。BLF載他因病在11月底卸任，遷居錫斯馬的拉帕拉莊園，1946年10月25日去世。
body.en: The RUL record shows Walden was appointed Minister of Defence on 27 March 1940 and served continuously until 27 November 1944; BLF says he continued in the governments of Ryti, Rangell, Linkomies and Hackzell and took part for a third time in a delegation negotiating with the Russians. On 2 December 1944 he was made a Knight of the Mannerheim Cross. BLF says illness forced him to leave the cabinet at the end of November; he moved to his estate at Rapaala in Sysmä, where he died on 25 October 1946.

heading.zh-Hant: 自由戰爭與冬季戰爭中的軍事任務
heading.en: Military roles in the 1918 war of independence and the Winter War

body.zh-Hant: BLF稱瓦爾登在自由戰爭（1918年內戰）與冬季戰爭中承擔重要的軍事任務，但來源並未記載他指揮具體會戰。RUL簡歷載，1918年2月20日他出任瓦薩防衛團區長，3月5日起任總司令部後勤長，5月6日任被占領地區安全長。冬季戰爭爆發時，他是軍備委員會主席；該委員會撤銷後，BLF載1939年12月他以預備役少將身分被召回現役，任總司令駐政府代表。他並隨代表團於1940年3月赴莫斯科議和，戰後出任國防部長。
body.en: BLF says Walden held important military assignments during the war of independence of 1918 and the Winter War, though the sources do not record him commanding any specific battle. The RUL record shows he became chief of the Vaasa Civil Guard district on 20 February 1918, head of the supply service at headquarters on 5 March, and chief for securing the conquered areas on 6 May. When the Winter War began he chaired the War Materiel Council; after its dissolution, BLF says he was called back in December 1939 as a major general in the reserve and served as the commander-in-chief's representative in the cabinet. He joined the delegation that made peace in Moscow in March 1940 and then became Minister of Defence.

heading.en: Birth and the 1918 war

body.zh-Hant: 據瑞典語芬蘭百科（Uppslagsverket Finland），庫斯塔·安德斯·塔波拉1895年3月29日生於萊姆佩萊（Lempäälä）。他在參加1918年內戰之後被任命為軍官，並於1926年自戰爭學院畢業。
body.en: According to Uppslagsverket Finland, Kustaa Anders Tapola was born in Lempäälä on 29 March 1895. He was commissioned as an officer after taking part in the 1918 war and graduated from the War College in 1926.

citations.quote: f. 29/3 1895 Lempäälä
Tapola befordrades till officer efter sitt deltagande i kriget 1918
utexaminerades från Krigshögskolan 1926

heading.en: Winter War and Continuation War

body.zh-Hant: 冬季戰爭期間，塔波拉任卡累利阿地峽軍參謀長。繼續戰爭中他曾指揮第5師，並在1944年奧涅加地峽（Aunus）的撤退戰役中率領該師。1944年11月18日他獲頒曼納海姆十字勳章，是第160號騎士。
body.en: During the Winter War Tapola was chief of staff of the Army of the Karelian Isthmus. In the Continuation War he commanded, among other units, the 5th Division, which he led in the difficult retreat battles on the Aunus (Olonets) Isthmus in 1944. On 18 November 1944 he received the Mannerheim Cross as knight no. 160.

citations.quote: Under vinterkriget var han stabschef vid Karelska näsets armé
i fortsättningskriget förde han bl.a. befälet över 5. Divisionen
under de svåra reträttstriderna på Aunusnäset (Olonetsnäset) 1944
Mannerheimriddare nr 160 (18/11 1944)

heading.en: Postwar posts and death

body.zh-Hant: 戰後塔波拉任國防審查委員會成員（1945至1949年）、最高法院軍事成員（1947至1965年）、步兵總監（1948至1955年），以及國防經濟規劃代表團主席（1955至1958年）。他1955年升步兵上將，1971年4月2日卒於赫爾辛基。
body.en: After the war Tapola was a member of the defence audit board (1945–49), military member of the Supreme Court (1947–65), Inspector of Infantry (1948–55) and chairman of the defence economic planning delegation (1955–58). He became general of infantry in 1955 and died in Helsinki on 2 April 1971.
